subject.title: fix(cron): bound alerts and complete heartbeat cleanup

question: After lint is green and real runtime proof is attached, should the Gateway owner accept this bounded cron reliability and lookup change on the current head?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision, and the supplied context is insufficient to independently establish whole-surface current-main ownership and runtime proof.

options.title: Review after proof and lint
options.body: Require the contributor to attach redacted after-fix runtime evidence and resolve the failed lint check, then review the exact head.

options.title: Pause for a narrower follow-up
options.body: If the three changes should be separated for ownership or rollout reasons, ask for focused follow-up PRs instead of merging this combined branch.

recommendation.title: Review after proof and lint
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to attach redacted after-fix runtime evidence and resolve the failed lint check, then review the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history connects steipete to all three changed cron/Gateway paths, though current-main ownership needs confirmation.
